mapper.select: SELECT P.ID AS id, P.PERMISSION_CODE AS code, P.PERMISSION_NAME AS name, P.RESOURCE_TYPE AS resourceType FROM PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P WHERE P.DELEGABLE = 1 AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId}) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId})) AND (#{keyword} = '' OR P.PERMISSION_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.PERMISSION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.AUTH_YEAR = B.AUTH_YEAR AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID = P.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE B.MEMBER_REF_ID = #{memberRefId} AND B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND B.AUTH_YEAR = #{year} AND B.SCOPE_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND B.SCOPE_REF_ID IS NULL AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 ) ORDER BY P.PERMISSION_CODE, P.ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT M.ID AS id, M.MEMBER_ID AS code FROM PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M WHERE M.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (#{keyword} = '' OR M.MEMBER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY M.MEMBER_ID, M.ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT O.ID AS id, O.ORG_CODE AS code, O.ORG_NAME AS name FROM PEACH_ORGANIZATION O INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.TENANT_ID = O.TENANT_ID AND T.ID = #{tenantRefId} AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE O.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND O.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (#{keyword} = '' OR O.ORG_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR O.ORG_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY O.ORG_CODE, O.ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID FROM PEACH_ROLE R INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = R.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = R.APP_REF_ID) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = R.TENANT_REF_ID)) WHERE R.ID = #{roleRefId} AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND R.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND R.AUTH_YEAR = #{year} AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'TENANT' ORDER BY RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID LIMIT 201

SELECT B.ID AS id, R.ID AS roleRefId, R.ROLE_NAME AS name, B.SCOPE_TYPE AS scopeType, B.SCOPE_REF_ID AS scopeRefId FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M ON M.ID = B.MEMBER_REF_ID AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.AUTH_YEAR = B.AUTH_YEAR AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE B.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND B.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND B.AUTH_YEAR = #{year} AND B.MEMBER_REF_ID = #{memberRefId} AND B.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND B.IS_DELETE = 0 ORDER BY B.ID LIMIT 201
